transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?

Um... just having some issues at work, I guess. It's... I don't know. I just can't really shake this feeling that people there, and even some of the vendors, are tracking my buys. Like they're messing with the launch numbers just to make me look stupid. My supervisor keeps showing me the reports and saying they don't prove that, but... yeah. I guess that's why I came in.
Have you heard any voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

Um... yeah, I guess. Sometimes. Like... if I'm in the stockroom by myself, or driving back from a vendor meeting. I'll just hear this guy's voice. It sounds like it's right behind me. He just tells me to... to move faster, or he'll laugh at the picks I made. But then I turn around, and... nobody's there.
Alongside these experiences, how has your mood been lately—have you been feeling down or depressed?
No, not really. I mean... I guess I've been a little stressed with the work stuff, but... I wouldn't say depressed. Just normal, I guess.
About how long have you been hearing this voice and feeling like people at work are tracking you?
Um... I don't know exactly. A while, I guess. Maybe... roughly ten months? Yeah, about ten months of all that.
Have you been using any alcohol, cannabis, or other recreational drugs during this time?
No. I don't... I don't really do any of that.
